notes.title: Steam Acheivements
notes.notes: [p]Steam Achievements are now working as intended. Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Steam deleting Save data on update
notes.notes: [p]Upon updating the game, steam had been resetting saved data. [/p][p]The issue appears to have been resolved. I will also be looking into implementing cloud saves. [/p][p]Cheers![/p]

notes.notes: [h1]Bug Fixes: [/h1][olist][*][p]Level 5 LASER Bug has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Boss 2 checkpoints fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution settings now linked to Windowed mode toggle[/p][/*][/olist][h1]New Features:[/h1][olist][*][p]VSYNC toggle added to options menu[/p][/*][*][p]SFX and Music volume adjusters added to options menu[/p][/*][/olist][h1][/h1]

notes.title: Steam Deck
notes.notes: [p]It appears that Chiral is not yet compatible with Steam Deck. I will be looking into this further to see if this is something I can feasibly update for the game. [/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Chiral release date!
notes.notes: [p]Chiral's official release date has been set for August 15th 2025! Wishlist now if you haven't already![/p][p]I can't wait for you all to play it! [/p]
